}}'''Desaine''' was a [[Wise One]] of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].

== Appearance ==
She had gray hair with a leathery face.

== Activities ==
She was one of the Wise Ones that opposed [[Sevanna]]'s acting as clan chief of the Shaido. She could channel{{ref|Since Galina observes that all of the Wise Ones can channel except Sevanna.{{ref/book|6|53}}}}, though her strength is not known. Her entry in the Companion does not elaborate, like with most Wise Ones.

She was among the Wise Ones who had made an alliance with the [[White Tower]]. After [[Rand al'Thor]] was captured by the White Tower in accordance with the alliance, Desaine was murdered by her fellow Shaido Wise Ones under Sevanna's command both to quell the opposition of the Shaido Wise Ones against Sevanna's way and to use her death as a feign and a pretext.

Later, before [[Dumai's Wells]] battle, Sevanna used her death to convince both the Wise Ones and the Shaido to fight the Aes Sedai (fighting Aes Sedai was considered out of custom) treacherously claiming that Desaine was brutally murdered by the Aes Sedai themselves and they needed to avenge her for the Shaido's honor.
